title: Brainstorm x3w: Explore project context
description: Explore files, docs, recent commits, and existing beads for the multiple rules-pack design.
notes: Context findings: docs/storage.md already reserves <root>/rules-packs and says rules data resolves at runtime, not copied into campaign DBs. Current public seams are SRD-specific: packages/core/src/srd/*, lookup_srd in orchestrator/tools.ts, prompt text in orchestrator/protocol.ts, srdRef on module EncounterCreature, and SRD-only characterCreation.ts validation. Campaign identity currently stores module pack id in core campaign.ts and CLI registry.module; no campaign rules-pack binding exists. World PackLicense/evaluatePackPolicy already provides a license metadata pattern to reuse or generalize for rules packs. Recent main includes character creation before play turns (#48) and memory rollup work (#47/#49), so the design must preserve CLI character gating and close/session flows.
close_reason: Explored docs, code seams, tests, and recent commits; notes recorded on the bead.
